parsed.faithful: EXECUTION, in Laws, is where we often be free that it, made to be deceived after wards by entry, livery or writ. Leads for years, annuities, conditions, &c. are termed interviances exec-ency. EXECUTORY, in Law, is where an estate in fee, that is, made by deed or fine, is to be executed afterwards by entry, livery, or writ. Lease for years, annuities, conditions, &c. are termed inheritances exec-utory. EXECUTORY, in Scot. Law, is the movable estate
